response.overview: The search for proof of the legend of Bigfoot leads a young conspiracy theorist into the forest alone. Their passion confused with obsession and crazy has led to friends abandoning the hunt. Their determination to be right and it not all be for nothing drives them face to face with the myth itself, revealing the harsh reality of this hidden truth.
response.tagline: Leona a wildlife photographer sets out on a Bigfoot hunt alone. Years of unsuccessful hunting sessions soon come to an end, but the reality of these animals may be too much for her to handle.
response.title: The Untitled Bigfoot Short
